import re
txt=open('/veracity/case.md').read()

print()
print("all before 17:00:", not bad, "| violations:", bad)
latest=max(rows,key=lambda r:int(r[1])*60+int(r[2]))
print("latest delivery:",latest[0],f"{latest[1]}:{latest[2]}","margin to deadline:",deadline-(int(latest[1])*60+int(latest[2])),"min")
